name: Custom Name Buckle (spell "AK")
currency_note: USD, montanasilversmiths.com (Magento, checked in browser Oct 21 2026). Page shows 'In stock', $180. Lettering up to 8 capital letters; optional back engraving +$30. Made to order in Columbus, Montana, ships in about 6 weeks; custom sales final.
colorways: Silver engraved, gold rope trim, gold letters
why: The closest thing to Kim's 2008 custom 'AK' bling buckle under $200: an engraved silver oval with gold rope trim where you choose the letters, so it can literally read AK. Shown with sample name 'JAMES'.

name: Initial A Silver Engraved Gold Trim Western Belt Buckle (700A)
currency_note: USD, montanasilversmiths.com, page shows 'In stock', $140 (SKU 700A). Ships as stock, no custom wait. 3.75 x 2.75 in, fits a 1.5 in belt. Every letter A-Z sold separately (e.g. 700K).
colorways: Silver bright-cut scroll, gold rope trim, gold 'A'
why: A classic western trophy-style buckle with a single raised gold initial: the in-stock, ships-now version of the AK buckle, for readers who want the look without a six-week custom wait.

name: CLUCT Leather Belt
currency_note: USD, malbon.com (Shopify) /products/cluct-leather-belt-black.js?country=US: variant 'OS / BLACK' available, $128. NOTE: listed as PREORDER, ships by 10/30.
why: From Kim's own brand partner: Malbon x CLUCT water-buffalo leather belt finished in Japan, with a chunky engraved square buckle in brass under a thick 925 silver coating. A heavy silver buckle, toned down for now.

name: Custom Needlepoint Belt (stitch "AK")
currency_note: USD, charlestonbelt.com (Shopify) /products/custom-needlepoint-belt.js?country=US: all variants available. $195 for men's 1.25 in belts up to size 42 (base listing shows $150, which is the children's price); larger sizes cost slightly more, +$30 for licensed logos. Free digital proof before stitching; custom, so no returns.
why: A golf-world version of the personalised belt from a needlepoint maker TGI already covers: stitch AK (or a flag and AK) into the strap. The sample image includes initials ('CMT') and a First Tee design. Landscape sample image, so crop it.
